title: Chapter 106 The Saint Is Back
content:
Chapter 106 The Saint Is Back

At this time, at the border of the void land of the Wood Immortal Realm.

"Puff~"

Gongsun Sheng suddenly spat out a mouthful of blood, his face extremely ugly.

At this moment, he was not only because of the powerful backlash, but also because the other party actually took his power.

How is this possible? !

Is there anyone in the lower world who has such strength?

My strength is one of the best in the entire Wood Immortal Realm.

"Damn it!"

Then, Gongsun Sheng's face was ferocious, and he slowly raised his palm again, and the immortal power suddenly condensed from his hand.

This must be a coincidence.

If it happens again, he doesn't believe that the other party can still take it.

And just when he started, a terrifying pressure suddenly descended.

Buzz——

In an instant, the space where Gongsun Sheng was located collapsed directly, and endless black holes continued to condense and explode, and the breath was extremely terrifying.

"Get out!"

A roar sounded from the field.

With the breathtaking aura, Gongsun Sheng's face suddenly turned pale, as if he had sensed something extremely terrifying.

Thinking that it was not good, Gongsun Sheng took a deep look at the direction of the lower world, and then turned and left in a hurry.

Revenge can only be discussed later.

Hatred blinded his eyes, and he actually forgot that there was a great terror here.

The most urgent thing is to leave here as soon as possible.

Outside the void.

The people of the Immortal Holy Land are waiting outside anxiously at this moment.

Looking at the void in the void, everyone frowned.

This is not a good place.

For the Holy Lord who brought them here for revenge, many people still have some complaints in their hearts.

At this time, the barrier suddenly began to tremble slightly.

The next moment, Gongsun Sheng's anxious voice sounded from it.

"Help me!"

Hearing this, everyone was shocked, and then as if they had been prepared for a long time, they hurriedly urged their whole body of immortal power to suppress the breath in front of them.

Boom!

Accompanied by a roar, Gongsun Sheng rushed out of the void in a panic.

It is indeed one of the forbidden areas of the Wood Immortal Realm.

Even the Lord of the Holy Land, Gongsun Sheng, is in danger of falling if he enters.

"Lord Saint, what's wrong?"

At this time, a strong man from the Holy Land stepped forward and asked.

Hearing this, Gongsun Sheng's face was gloomy. He did not answer, but directly said: "Go back to the Holy Land first!"

In this way, Gongsun Sheng led the strong men from the Holy Land and ran back to the Holy Land in disgrace.

As soon as he returned to the Holy Land, Gongsun Sheng hurried into the retreat room and announced his retreat.

"Cough cough cough!"

He coughed up a few mouthfuls of blood, and Gongsun Sheng's face was visibly haggard.

"I don't believe it. You will never come to the Wood Immortal Realm in your life!"

Gongsun Sheng's face was ferocious, and his eyes seemed to be able to spit out real fire.

It can be seen how angry he was at this time.

Facing the provocation of a lower world ant, not only did he not have any way to deal with the other party, but he ended up getting seriously injured.

What a shame!

At this time, outside the holy land.

A woman in plain clothes walked slowly and barefoot to the holy land.

"Who are you? This is the holy land of immortals. All outsiders should leave immediately!"

Seeing the plain-clothed woman, a guard guarding the holy land shouted.

Hearing this, the plain-clothed woman had no expression on her face, but just walked silently into the holy land with very slow steps.

But for some reason, she had already arrived in front of the holy land in just three or two steps.

Seeing this scene, the guard's expression moved slightly, and he was about to speak.

At this time, a guard with a stronger aura heard the movement and flew over here.

"What's going on?"

"Captain, there is an outsider, and she is a little abnormal."

As he said, the guard pointed in the direction of the plain-clothed woman.

Hearing this, the captain of the guard looked over, and his face suddenly changed.

"Saintess!"

"Subordinates, pay homage to Saintess!"

For a moment, the entire Fairyland was completely shaken.

Saintess is back!

The pride of the Fairyland, known as the most talented person in the history of the Fairyland, and even rumored to have the potential to become an emperor.

Of course, the emperor here refers to the Fairy Emperor.

And the Saintess of the Fairyland has another identity, that is, the granddaughter of the Saint Lord Gongsun Sheng and the sister of Gongsun Yao.

Gongsun Mo.

"Where is my grandfather?"

After returning to the Holy Land, Gongsun Mo said expressionlessly.

A strong man from the Holy Land stepped forward and said, "Saintess, the Holy Lord just went into seclusion not long ago."

"Seclusion?"

Hearing the word "seclusion", Gongsun Mo frowned slightly.

"What about my sister, has she returned from the lower world?"

"This..."

Suddenly, the strong man from the Holy Land looked hesitant.

Seeing this, Gongsun Mo's face darkened, "Tell me! What happened? What happened to my sister?"

Gongsun Mo has always loved Gongsun Yao.

Because she always feels that she owes her sister.

Since Gongsun Yao was born, she has never received any attention. All the attention has been placed on her.

The best room, the best resources, and even the best status were all given to her.

And this also made Gongsun Yao's heart become a little twisted.

She has done all kinds of evil things since she was a child, just hoping to get everyone's attention, but the result is counterproductive. Most people in the entire holy land will be somewhat disgusted with her.

Until later, Gongsun Yao's grandfather Gongsun Sheng noticed his unpopular granddaughter, which was a discovery of conscience.

But everything is too late.

This is why Gongsun Yao took the risk of plundering Lu Xue's luck. All she did was to prove her worth.

At this time, Gongsun Mo had an unknown premonition, and his eyes were staring at the powerful man in the holy land in front of him.

At this moment, the powerful man in the Holy Land felt like he was being sanctioned.

How strong is the Saint now!

In the end, he still stammered and explained.

"Sir Saint, your sister has fallen in the lower realm."

boom!

As soon as he finished speaking, a violent aura suddenly burst out from Gongsun Mo's body.

In an instant, the entire fairy holy land felt this terrifying aura.

"That's, Saint?!"

"What a strong aura. Now the Saint Maiden is probably no less than the Saint Lord."

"I am worthy of being a saint, and my strength is so terrifying."

At this time, Gongsun Mo had reached the verge of explosion.

His sister actually fell.

She was a little unacceptable.

No matter how Gongsun Yao thinks of her, she will always be consistent with Gongsun Yao.

But at this moment, her sister can never come back.

Buzz —

At this time, another aura suddenly surged from the depths of the holy land, and in an instant, Gongsun Mo's aura was instantly suppressed.

And Gongsun Mo gradually calmed down.

After taking a deep look at the depths of the holy land, Gongsun Mo turned around and left.

"Sir, where are you going?"

The powerful man from the holy land looked at Gongsun Mo's back and said quickly.

Gongsun Mo said lightly without looking back: "Go to the lower realm and avenge my sister."

Hearing this, his face suddenly became stunned.

I wanted to say that the lower realm has the power of rules to limit it and cannot be removed, but I looked at the saint's firm back.

He swallowed this sentence immediately.

The Saint said so, so there must be a way.
